notes.title: Minute Of Islands review: a grim world drawn in a wonderful, elegant way
notes.content:
Puzzle-platformer Minute Of Islands sort of feels like a fairytale. Like a lot of stories for kids, the narration is simple, almost sing-song and poetic in tone. It tells the story of Mo, a self-taught engineer who lives mostly underground, tending to the bio-mechanical engines operated by four giants - brothers, in fact. The brothers hand-crank the machines to filter and purify the air, which would otherwise become filled with poisonous fungal spores.

When the engines break down one day, Mo must brave the surface, checking on her family and growing increasingly paranoid and bitter at her unappreciated sacrifice as she breathes in the spores. But the actual events, and the things you see as you jump and climb around the archipelago Mo lives on, present a jarring contrast to the narration. The narrator points out a dead whale. She does not describe the way the whales intenstines are spilling onto the beach, the bones of its spine are exposed, or how its eyes have been eaten by mangy, one-legged seagulls.

Read more

notes.title: Minute of Islands' Release Postponed
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We all know (especially after a year of a global pandemic) that things don’t always go according to plan. This is, unfortunately, the case with Minute of Island, which has hit some unforeseen snags. As much as we had fully hoped and intended to bring Minute of Islands to stores on March 18, some significant last-minute issues appeared during our last round of testing. This means that it’s with a heavy heart that we’ve decided to push the release on all platforms to a later date. 

As you can appreciate, we want to give you the best possible gaming experience Rest assured that the extra time invested is spent in your best interest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35590278/69f41ad14a3e8d7f85d67e18f4196798bf69e35a.png[/img]

As we don’t want to disappoint you or make any false promises, we’re reluctant to set a fixed new date for the release until we’re 110% sure that all known bugs have been fixed that could affect the players’ experience. We’ll let you know about any updates as soon as possible - here as well as on Twitter and Facebook.   

We appreciate your patience and hope you’ll bear with us and remain as excited as we are for Minute of Islands’ final release. 

Take care
 - Team [i]Minute of Islands[/i]

notes.title: Inner World dev's beautiful narrative puzzler Minute of Islands has been delayed
notes.content:
Studio Fizbin, the developer behind acclaimed point-and-click adventure series The Inner World, has delayed the release of its beautiful narrative puzzle platformer Minute of Islands, meaning it'll no longer launch on 18th March as originally planned.

Minute of Islands charts the adventures of a young engineer named Mo as she journeys across a procession of beautifully distinct islands, meeting new characters and uncovering forgotten secrets in an attempt to save her archipelago home from a disaster of ancient origins.

Eurogamer's Christian Donlan was thoroughly charmed by Minute of Islands' early moments when he took the Steam Game Festival demo for a spin last month, calling it a "neat blend of exploration, traversal and puzzle solving", both fascinating and disquieting.

Read more

notes.title: Steam Game Festival: The Minute of Islands demo is a creepy, slithery delight
notes.content:
A quick glance at Minute of Islands and I wanted in. Here were blue skies and bright sou'westers, a story book adventure about a girl and a boat and an archipelago of some sort.

When I played the demo, though, which is available as part of the Steam Game Festival, I realised that Minute of Islands is actually rather different. Look again: this isn't a children's book style. It's the thin lines and eager rot of 1980s underground comics.

That sou'wester is Hazmat yellow, and this adventure doesn't start on the open wave but deep underground, in biomechanical corridors and ear canal spaces where machinery has gone wrong and the air is poisoned.

Read more

notes.title: The Inner World dev sets March release date for "poetic" narrative puzzler Minute of Islands
notes.content:
Studio Fizbin, the developer behind acclaimed point-and-click adventure series The Inner World, has set an 18th March release date for its striking "narrative puzzle platformer" Minute of Islands, which is coming to Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, Mac, and PC.

Minute of Islands charts the adventures of a young engineer named Mo as she attempts to save the archipelago of her home, once inhabited by a race of giants, from encroaching disaster.

"Otherworldly but vital machines, festering in the underbellies of the islands themselves, must be kept going or an almost forgotten threat will swallow all," explains Minute of Islands' Steam page. "Mo vows to restore the hidden engines in time, but is this truly what she needs?".

Fronted by that fast-talking internet lad from Zero Punctuation, the showcase kicked off today’s festivities with a flood of 80 game trailers over a 2-hour run-time. Frankly, that’s a lotta games, so here’s our rundown of what you may have missed.

notes.title: Screenshot Saturday Sundays: Letting the sun set on windmills, androids and dusty old towers
notes.content:
Screenshot Saturday! That time of week where game developers and hobbyists subject their unfinished works for public scrutiny. This week: Watching the evening roll in over storm-rattled windmills, windswept towers, and Louisiana androids. Oh, and one mean-as-hell duck.

(more…)

notes.title: Heading to PAX East
notes.content:
We're thrilled to showcase Minute of Islands at the Indie MEGABOOTH at PAX East 2020 on Thursday and Friday, February 27-28. 

This time, we'll take something very special to the show: a brand-new demo of the game - so if you happen to visit PAX East, you can be among the first persons who get their eyes and hands on it!

Come say hi and play Minute of Islands in the Minibooth area (booth number: 21051) - looking forward to meeting you there!

[previewyoutube=AmQhnfD-LPo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Screenshot Saturday Sundays: Cosy kitchens, loadsa loot, and glowing greenery
notes.content:
Screenshot Saturday! A day for celebrating games in progress and alliteration alike. This week: the comforts of a lived-in home, a deep well of rewards, and a whole forest of bioluminescence.

(more…)

notes.title: Coming up: EGX Berlin
notes.content:
With Gamescom and PAX West done, it’s time to look ahead to new challenges and chances to meet indie game enthusiasts like you. 

So here’s something we see in the near future: EGX Berlin is less than 2 months away and we are very happy to announce that “Minute of Islands” is one of 50 indie games selected to be shown there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33168999/f207c1dd2406004432c0fbcf76070626feb3efc8.gif[/img]

EGX Berlin takes place November 1 – 3 at the Station (Luckenwalder Str. 4 – 6, Berlin). 
If you happen to be in Berlin at that time, drop in at our booth, give “Minute of Islands” a go, have a chat with us, grab some stickers … or maybe even treat us to some coffee (much needed during expos). Looking forward to meeting you there! 

Check out the complete line-up of playable indies at: [url=https://www.egx.net/berlin/2019/playable-indies]https://www.egx.net/berlin/2019/playable-indies[/url]
Grab your tickets at: [url=https://www.egx.net/berlin/tickets]https://www.egx.net/berlin/tickets[/url]

Take care
-	Alexandra, Team Minute of Islands

notes.title: Minute of Islands - Come play!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33168999/ae9d26b90f5312db081cf74985147b0251a118a9.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

Studio Fizbin and Mixtvision have teamed up to bring you [b]the beautiful and enigmatic puzzle-platformer Minute of Islands[/b], coming to Steam (and consoles) in early 2020!

If you're a fan of environmental puzzle gameplay and/or hand-drawn old-school comic visuals, this game might just be for you. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33168999/1560a2bbcb536cfe3aa6ec2cca3da4312f02af1a.png[/img]

[h1]Come play at Gamescom & PAX West[/h1]

And if you happen to be one of the lucky few able to attend either or even both of Gamescom and PAX West this year, you're welcome to drop by at our spots:

[b]Gamescom / Indie Arena Booth[/b]
Hall 10.2, 021G
More IAB good stuff here: https://indiearenabooth.de

[b]Pax West / Indie Megabooth[/b]
Minibooth Area (Sunday & Monday only!)
More juicy IMB news here: https://indiemegabooth.com

Also, we'll probably/definitely/maybe™ be streaming from Gamescom RIGHT HERE ON STEAM! Amazing, I know. Stay tuned for more info on that.

Have a great day out there!

– Frieder, Team Minute of Islands
